text:
marta: Heads-up — we're aiming for a coordinated release across API, runtime, console, and router in the 02:00 UTC change window. Need quick alignment on pins + rollback gates.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Canary will run on 5% traffic for 15m then 25% for 15m. Will post status updates.

alan: Which exact versions are we pushing?

marta: runtime v2.14.1 (quant fix), router v1.9.0 (header routing), console v0.28.3 (release notes page + telemetry), api service pinned to v3.8.4 but keeping v3.8.2 available as immediate fallback.

sophie: ack. Confirming console uses the new schema change? Last time that broke trace links.

ryan: console v0.28.3 includes schema v2026-03-clarified-trace. It keeps a feature-flag toggle: USE_NEW_TRACES=false by default for canary.

alan: Good. For runtime, what's the rollback criteria?

marta: Proposed rollback triggers: >5% 5m request error spike OR p50 token latency increase >200ms OR canary health != 100% for 5m. If any of those hit, we auto-failover to pinned fallback per service.

infra-bot: NOTE: Cluster eu-west-1 has scheduled maintenance 03:00-03:45 UTC. Avoid routing full traffic until 03:45.

marta: Thanks infra-bot — we'll cap traffic shift so region isn't fully shifted until maintenance window clears. Canary will be global but limited.

deploybot: Preflight checks: health checks OK, [db-migrations none], kv-schema unchanged. Rolling out canary groups: group-a (5%), group-b ready (25%). Will annotate release with rollback criteria.

alan: One more: router v1.9.0 requires header-splitting config. Adding small config snippet here for ops to apply: ```yaml
router.split_rules:
  - name: legacy -> route to v1
  - name: new -> route to v1.9.x
```

sophie: Ops runbook updated in GH: /ops/release/runbooks/stitchpoint.md — includes the exact steps to flip the console trace flag and to verify router split.

ryan: During canary, I'll watch token-cache hit rate; runtime change touches KV eviction heuristics. If we see cache miss rate up by >8% baseline, hold traffic.

marta: Decision: pin API to v3.8.4 for canary. If anything critical, fallback to v3.8.2 (instant pin). Runtime and router will have auto-fallback to previous minor (runtime v2.13.x, router v1.8.x). Console fallback is a config toggle to USE_NEW_TRACES=false and rollback of frontend artifact.

deploybot: Canary started (02:00 UTC). Group-a 5% live -> running health probes. Posting status updates here.

alan: Quick smoke: auth flows ✅, long-poll websocket session ✅, embeding endpoints responding ✅.

ryan: token-cache miss +3% so far, within noise. Observability dashboards good.

marta: If anything looks off, ping @oncall and add "rollback" label. Keep notes in the release thread.

deploybot: Canary green at 5% -> promoting to 25% (02:15 UTC). Monitoring same gates.

infra-bot: Reminder: don't exceed 70% cluster CPU in eu-west-1 due to maintenance.

alan: Noted. I'll be watching API error budget closely.

marta: Thanks team. If no alarms by 02:45 we'll complete rollout. If rollback needed, steps: 1) deploybot revert -> pinned fallback, 2) ops revert router split, 3) console toggle and frontend rollback, 4) runtime revert to v2.13.x.

ryan: LGTM. I'll stay on standby until 03:00 UTC.

sophie: +1. I'll update release notes with the canary results and the explicit rollback criteria.

deploybot: Rollout complete to 100% at 02:50 UTC — all gates green. Marking release as stable.

marta: Great work. Postmortem if we see regressions in 24h, but closing thread for now. :tada:
